mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the matrix definition lets Alloy invent any (Relationship, OperationKind) cell. The injected fact forces a Sharee-can-delete cell, which directly violates the least-privilege and Q3=B sharee-cannot-delete invariants.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { ShareeRel -> DeleteTask in PermMatrix.Allowed and ShareeRel -> PatchTaskShared in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the 'exactly one created entry per task' fact lets Alloy build a task with no created audit entry, which is exactly what AuditCompleteness must reject.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenessViolation { some t: Task | no a: AuditEntry | a.auditTask = t and a.auditOp = OpCreated }

mutation_targets.rationale: Append-only forbids two deletion entries for the same task. Clearing the fact and forcing two such entries directly exhibits the mutation/replay scenario the assertion must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj a1, a2: AuditEntry | a1.auditTask = a2.auditTask and a1.auditOp = OpDeleted and a2.auditOp = OpDeleted }

mutation_targets.rationale: If the actor-in-team constraint is removed, a user in team T could be recorded as having mutated a task in team U — exactly the cross-team leak that FR-014's byte-equivalent 404 is built to prevent.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamLeakViolation { some a: AuditEntry | a.actor.userTeam != a.auditTask.taskTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without the snapshot-matches-actor constraint, Alloy can fabricate an audit entry whose recorded role contradicts the actor's actual role, exhibiting misattribution.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some a: AuditEntry | a.actorRoleSnapshot != a.actor.userRole }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the same-team constraint on sharedWith allows a cross-team user_id in the share list, which FR-012 forbids and OwnershipBasedAccess is structured to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamShareViolation { some t: Task, u: t.sharedWith | u.userTeam != t.taskTeam }
